# VEX parser fixture provenance

- `openvex/openvex-spec-minimal.json` is the minimal OpenVEX document shown in the OpenVEX specification, retrieved from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openvex/spec/main/OPENVEX-SPEC.md` on 2026-08-15. It is copied without semantic changes.
- `cyclonedx-vex/official-vex-1.4.json` is the official CycloneDX VEX example from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CycloneDX/bom-examples/master/VEX/vex.json`, retrieved on 2026-08-15 without modification.

These fixtures establish parser compatibility only. They do not establish source authenticity or a finding-to-release mapping.
